questions.quote: II. 1. A: Heterotrophs do not produce their own food. R: They depend on autotrophs for their nourishment.

en.q:
Assertion [A]: Heterotrophs do not produce their own food.
Reason [R]: They depend on autotrophs for their nourishment.
options: Both [A] and [R] are true and [R] is the correct explanation of [A]
Both [A] and [R] are true but [R] is not the correct explanation of [A]
en.explanation: Consumers (heterotrophs) depend directly or indirectly on producers (autotrophs).

questions.quote: 2. A: Hotspots are the regions characterised by numerous endemic plants and animal species living in a vulnerable environment. R: To manage and focus on conservation work more effectively, researchers identified hotspots.

en.q:
Assertion [A]: Hotspots are regions with numerous endemic plant and animal species living in a vulnerable environment.
Reason [R]: To focus conservation work more effectively, researchers identified hotspots.
options: Both [A] and [R] are true and [R] is the correct explanation of [A]
Both [A] and [R] are true but [R] is not the correct explanation of [A]
en.explanation: Both are true, but [R] gives the purpose of identifying hotspots, not the reason why such regions have endemic species. (Book key not printed; answer judged by the reviewer's reading.)
